# Keystone Impact Solutions

> Funding strategy and grant management for purpose-led organisations in the environment, conservation and sustainability sector. Based in Australia, working with clients worldwide.

Keystone Impact Solutions is run by Dr Jess Hodgson, a PhD ecologist and funding strategist who finds, writes and manages grants, awards and funder relationships for conservation, environment and sustainability organisations, nonprofit or for-profit.

## Services

- [Grant Scout](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/grant-scout.html): Monthly grant finding service matched to an organisation's eligibility. $440/month (Focused Finder) or $770/month (Grant Ready), month to month, no lock-in. Grant writing is available as an add-on, quoted per grant.
- [Strategic Funding Partnership](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/strategic-funding-partnership.html): Full ownership of an organisation's funding pipeline: opportunities found, applications written, the team coached to win, and funder relationships managed.
- [Keystone Scout](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/keystone-scout.html): Monthly grant and award scouting, giving one integrated view across both landscapes.
- [Awards](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/awards.html): Award Scout (landscape mapping), Award Watch (ongoing monitoring), and Award Story (award submission writing).
- [Services overview](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/services.html): How the offers fit together and how to choose between them.

## About

- [About Dr Jess Hodgson](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/about.html): PhD ecologist background, why a scientist owns the funding, and the Keystone Impact Solutions story.
- [Case studies](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/case-studies.html): Real client projects and outcomes.
- [Impact Intel](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/impact-intel.html): Weekly insights on grants, awards, funder strategy and philanthropy for purpose-led organisations.

## Optional

- [Grant Readiness Self-Assessment](https://keystoneimpactsolutions.au/grant-readiness-assessment.html): Free self-assessment tool.
